entities.name: Antônio Conselheiro
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Antônio Conselheiro, in English "Anthony the Counselor", real name Antônio Vicente Mendes Maciel, was a Brazilian religious leader, preacher and founder of the village of Canudos, the scene of the War of Canudos (1896–1897), a civil rebellion against the central government which was brutally stamped out with the loss of more than 25,000 lives.
